m: सम्-ए (-आ √ 5. इ) P. -ऐति (pr. p. -एयान, MBh.), to come together, approach together, meet at or in (acc. or loc.) or with (instr. with or without समम्), go to or across, arrive at (acc.), RV. &c. &c.; to unite with (instr.) in marriage, R.; to enter, Hit.; to emulate, cope with (acc.), R.; (with योगम्) to lead or join together, form an alliance between (gen.) and (instr.), ŚvetUp. (= सं-गमय्य, Śaṃk.)
a: समे — {c2c} P. 1 To come together or meet; समेत्य च व्यपेयातां H. 4. 69. --2 To go through, march across.

m: सम्-√ एध् Ā. -एधते, to prosper greatly, thrive, increase, AV.; BhP. : Caus. -एधयति, to cause to prosper or succeed, make happy or fortunate, increase, swell, strengthen, ĀśvGṛ.; MBh. &c.
a: समेध् — {c1c} A. To prosper greatly, thrive, increase. --Caus. 1 To make happy or fortunate. --2 To feed, supply with, strengthen; सूर्यः समेधयत्बग्निमग्निः सूर्बं च तेजसा V. 5. 20.

m: स-मेध mfn. full of strength or vitality, vigorous, TS.
सम्-एधन n. thriving, prospering, growth, increase, R.

v: tri॰ sam + eGa + Ric--kta । saMvardDite “maDusamfdDi sameDitameDayayeti” mAGaH ।
m: सम्-˚एधित mfn. greatly increased or augmented, swelled, increased, strengthened, made happy or fortunate, MBh.; R.; BhP.
a: समेधित — p. p. 1 Greatly increased; Śi. 6. 20. --2 Strong. --3 United.

m: स-मेघ-लेख mfn. having streaks of cloud, MW.
सम्-एद्धृ mfn. one who kindles, kindling, RV.
सम्-√ एज् P. -एजति, to rise, get in motion, RV.; MBh.
समेडी f. N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda (cf. भेडी), MBh.
सम्-एर् (-आ-√ ईर्, only in 3. pl. pf. Ā. -एरिरे), to put together, create, RV. x, 40, 4.

s: tri, (sam + A + iR + ktaH .) samyakprAptaH । saMyuktaH । yaTA, -- “nAmasametaM kftasaNketaM vAdayate mfdu veRum । bahu manute tanute tanusaNgatapavanacalitamapi reRum ॥” iti SrIjayadevaH ॥
v: tri॰ sam + A--iRa kta । 1 samAgate 2 saNgate ca ।
m: सम्-एत mfn. come together, assembled, joined, united, Mn.; MBh. &c.
connected or united or furnished with, possessed of (instr. or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
encountered, come into collision with (instr.), MBh.
come near or to, got into any state or condition (acc.), Pañcat.
a: समेत — p. p. 1 Come or met together, assembled. --2 United, combined. --3 Come near, approached. --4 Accompanied by. --5 Endowed or furnished with, having, possessed of; Pt. 1. 24. --6 Come into collision, encountered. --7 Agreed upon.

m: सम्-एत—माय mfn. affected by or possessing illusions, MW.
